title: Nonhomogeneous boundary condition for spectral non-local operators
summary: We study semilinear non-local elliptic problems driven by spectral-type operators of the form $ψ(-L_{|D})$ in a bounded $C^{1,1}$ domain $D\subset \mathbb{R}^d$ with a nonhomogeneous boundary condition. Here $ψ$ is a Bernstein function satisfying a weak scaling condition at infinity, and $L_{|D}$ is the generator of a killed Lévy process. This general framework covers and extends the theory of the interpolated fractional Laplacian.
